_comment: A buff is a set of modifiers with an expiry and an icon. It is not a second way to change a number: every effect here is an ordinary modifier, resolved through Rules alongside rulesets, trinkets, traits and Palace adjacency. Expiry is wall-clock (HJClock.now), so a buff survives the app being killed and expires while it is closed. Two kinds: `hours` is a timer, `break_on` is a condition someone else calls Buffs.trigger() for. `then` chains a second buff on expiry, which is what makes coffee cost something.

buffs.name: Boon of the White Room
buffs.desc: Walking costs you nothing while you are inside.
buffs.apply_text: The room lets you move for free. It will not follow you out.
buffs.expire_text: The Boon of the White Room breaks. Steps cost steps now.

buffs.name: Coffee
buffs.desc: Faster on your feet for three hours.
buffs.apply_text: Hot, and a little too strong. You feel quicker already.
buffs.expire_text: The coffee lets go of you.

buffs.name: The crash
buffs.desc: What the coffee was borrowing against.
buffs.apply_text: And there it is. Everything is further away than it was.
buffs.expire_text: The crash passes. You feel like yourself again.

buffs.name: Breakfast
buffs.desc: Half again as much Grit for four hours.
buffs.apply_text: Eaten standing up, which still counts.
